# Published daily baseline

`before-v7.json` was captured from the previously built application before adding the November 3, 2026 edition. Its original TypeScript was recovered from existing source maps (`index-Cu5MeT2Q.js.map` and `mode3d-Bxv26aS0.js.map`), bundled with the test harness, and evaluated independently of the new generators.

Each row freezes the dated recipe; all five shapes’ vector parts, rotation, mirroring, mass center, inertia, sprite fit and offsets; and the complete material-weighted 3D set. Hashes cover October 21 through November 2 inclusive. Do not refresh this fixture from the current implementation.
